Fall Line HouseArchitecture in motion

The concept / 001

Nature is the architecture.

Fall Line House is an architectural visualization study exploring the contrast between exposed concrete, warm walnut and the raw energy of a waterfall.

This interactive prototype is a photographic, scroll-led experience using the supplied architectural renders.
